‘The six-night mānatta on account of three offenses has been granted by the Saṅgha to the monk Udāyī. It is agreeable to the Saṅgha; therefore, it is silent. Thus do I hold this.’

Mānattacārikamūlāyapaṭikassanā

Relegation to the beginning for one undergoing mānatta

116. So mānattaṃ caranto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ appaṭicchannaṃ. So bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi – “ahaṃ, āvuso, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… [T 1.0189] sohaṃ mānattaṃ caranto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ appaṭicchannaṃ. Kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti? Bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “Tena hi, bhikkhave, saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassitvā chārattaṃ mānattaṃ detu. Evañca pana, bhikkhave, mūlāya paṭikassitabbo – tena, bhikkhave, udāyinā bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā…pe… evamassa vacanīyo – ‘ahaṃ, bhante[V 0.0112], ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… [T 1.0190] sohaṃ mānattaṃ caranto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ appaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ, bhante, saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yācāmī’ti. Dutiyampi yācitabbā. Tatiyampi yācitabbā. “Byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo –

116. While undergoing probation, he committed one intervening offence of intentional emission of semen, which was unconcealed. He informed the monks: 'Friends, I committed one offence of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days… and so on… While undergoing probation, I committed one intervening offence of intentional emission of semen, which was unconcealed. How then should I proceed?' They reported this matter to the Blessed One. 'In that case, monks, let the Saṅgha, having reverted the monk Udāyī to the beginning on account of one intervening, unconcealed offence of intentional emission of semen, give him a six-night probation. And, monks, he should be reverted to the beginning thus: That monk Udāyī, monks, should approach the Saṅgha… and so on… and he should speak thus: 'Venerable sirs, I committed one offence of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days… and so on… While undergoing probation, I committed one intervening offence of intentional emission of semen, which was unconcealed. Venerable sirs, I ask the Saṅgha for reversion to the beginning on account of one intervening, unconcealed offence of intentional emission of semen.' He should ask a second time. He should ask a third time. A competent and capable monk should inform the Saṅgha:

117. “Suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu…pe… [T 1.0191] mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yācati[T 1.0192]. Yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikasseyya. Esā ñatti…pe… [T 1.0193] paṭikassito saṅghena udāyī bhikkhu antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā [M 0.0119] appaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanā. Khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.

117. Venerable sirs, let the Saṅgha hear me. This monk Udāyī... asks for reversion to the beginning. If the time is suitable for the Saṅgha, the Saṅgha should revert the monk Udāyī to the beginning on account of one intervening offence of intentional emission of semen, which was unconcealed. This is the motion... The monk Udāyī has been reverted to the beginning by the Saṅgha on account of one intervening offence of intentional emission of semen, which was unconcealed. This is approved by the Saṅgha, therefore it is silent. Thus I take it.

“Evañca pana, bhikkhave, chārattaṃ mānattaṃ dātabbaṃ – tena, bhikkhave, udāyinā bhikkhunā…pe… evamassa vacanīyo – ‘ahaṃ, bhante, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… sohaṃ mānattaṃ caranto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ appaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya [T 1.0194] sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāciṃ. Taṃ maṃ saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. Sohaṃ, bhante, saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yācāmī’ti. Dutiyampi yācitabbaṃ. Tatiyampi yācitabbaṃ. Byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo –

And thus, monks, probation for six nights should be given. That monk Udāyī... should speak thus: 'Venerable sirs, I committed one offence of intentional emission of semen, which was concealed for five days... While undergoing probation, I committed one intervening offence of intentional emission of semen, which was unconcealed. I asked the Saṅgha for reversion to the beginning on account of one intervening offence of intentional emission of semen, which was unconcealed. The Saṅgha reverted me to the beginning on account of one intervening offence of intentional emission of semen, which was unconcealed. Venerable sirs, I ask the Saṅgha for probation for six nights on account of one intervening offence of intentional emission of semen, which was unconcealed.' He should ask a second time. He should ask a third time. A competent and capable monk should inform the Saṅgha:

“Suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu…pe… chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yācati. Yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ dadeyya. Esā ñatti…pe… [T 1.0195] dinnaṃ saṅghena udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ. Khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.

Venerable sirs, let the Saṅgha hear me. This monk Udāyī... asks for probation for six nights. If the time is suitable for the Saṅgha, the Saṅgha should give the monk Udāyī probation for six nights on account of one intervening, unconcealed offence of intentional emission of semen. This is the motion... Probation for six nights has been given by the Saṅgha to the monk Udāyī on account of one intervening, unconcealed offence of intentional emission of semen. It is approved by the Saṅgha, therefore it is silent. Thus I hold it.

Abbhānārahamūlāyapaṭikassanā

Reversion to the Beginning for One Worthy of Reinstatement

118. So [T 1.0196][V 0.0113] ciṇṇamānatto abbhānāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ appaṭicchannaṃ. So bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi – “ahaṃ, āvuso, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… sohaṃ ciṇṇamānatto abbhānāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ appaṭicchannaṃ. Kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti? Bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “Tena hi, bhikkhave, saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassitvā chārattaṃ mānattaṃ detu. Evañca pana, bhikkhave, mūlāya paṭikassitabbo…pe….

118. He, having completed probation and being worthy of reinstatement, committed one intervening, unconcealed offence of intentional emission of semen. He informed the monks: 'Friends, I committed one offence of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days... I, having completed probation and being worthy of reinstatement, committed one intervening, unconcealed offence of intentional emission of semen. How then should I proceed?' They reported this matter to the Blessed One. 'In that case, monks, let the Saṅgha, having reverted the monk Udāyī to the beginning on account of one intervening, unconcealed offence of intentional emission of semen, give him probation for six nights. And, monks, he should be reverted to the beginning in this way...'

“Evañca [M 0.0120] pana, bhikkhave, chārattaṃ mānattaṃ dātabbaṃ…pe….

And thus, monks, probation for six nights should be given...

“Dinnaṃ saṅghena udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ. Khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.

Probation for six nights has been given by the Saṅgha to the monk Udāyī on account of one intervening, unconcealed offence of intentional emission of semen. It is approved by the Saṅgha, therefore it is silent. Thus I hold it.

Mūlāyapaṭikassitaabbhānaṃ

Reinstatement of one Reverted to the Beginning

119. So ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi – “ahaṃ, āvuso, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… sohaṃ [P 2.0047] ciṇṇamānatto. Kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti? Bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. Tena hi, bhikkhave, saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ abbhetu. Evañca pana, bhikkhave, abbhetabbo –

119. Having completed probation, he informed the monks: 'Friends, I committed one offence of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days... I have completed probation. How then should I proceed?' They reported this matter to the Blessed One. 'In that case, monks, let the Saṅgha reinstate the monk Udāyī. And, monks, he should be reinstated in this way:'

“Tena, bhikkhave, udāyinā [T 1.0197] bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā…pe… evamassa vacanīyo – ‘ahaṃ, bhante, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya pañcāhaparivāsaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya pañcāhaparivāsaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ parivasanto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ appaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāciṃ. Taṃ maṃ saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā [V 0.0114] appaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. Sohaṃ parivutthaparivāso mānattāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ appaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāciṃ. Taṃ maṃ saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. Sohaṃ parivutthaparivāso saṅghaṃ tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ mānattaṃ caranto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ [T 1.0198] appaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāciṃ. Taṃ maṃ saṅgho [M 0.0121] antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ ciṇṇamānatto abbhānāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ appaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāciṃ. Taṃ maṃ saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ, bhante, ciṇṇamānatto saṅghaṃ abbhānaṃ yācāmī’”ti.

“Then, monks, the monk Udāyī should approach the Saṅgha … and say this: ‘Venerable sirs, I committed one offense: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. I, that one, requested the Saṅgha for a five-day probation for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. The Saṅgha granted me a five-day probation for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. I, that one, while undergoing probation, in the interim committed one offense: an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. I, that one, requested the Saṅgha to be sent back to the beginning for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha sent me, that one, back to the beginning for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed, committed in the interim. I, that one, having completed the probation and being eligible for mānatta, in the interim committed one offense: an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. I, that one, requested the Saṅgha to be sent back to the beginning for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha sent me, that one, back to the beginning for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed, committed in the interim. I, that one, having completed the probation, requested the Saṅgha for a six-night mānatta for the three offenses. The Saṅgha granted me a six-night mānatta for the three offenses. I, that one, while undertaking mānatta, in the interim committed one offense: an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. I, that one, requested the Saṅgha to be sent back to the beginning for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha sent me, that one, back to the beginning for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed, committed in the interim. I, that one, requested the Saṅgha for a six-night mānatta for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha granted me a six-night mānatta for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed, committed in the interim. I, that one, having completed mānatta and being eligible for rehabilitation, in the interim committed one offense: an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. I, that one, requested the Saṅgha to be sent back to the beginning for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha sent me, that one, back to the beginning for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed, committed in the interim. I, that one, requested the Saṅgha for a six-night mānatta for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha granted me a six-night mānatta for that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, unconcealed, committed in the interim. Venerable sirs, I, that one, having completed mānatta, ask the Saṅgha for rehabilitation.’”

“Dutiyampi yācitabbaṃ. Tatiyampi yācitabbaṃ. Byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo –

It should be requested a second time. It should be requested a third time. The Saṅgha should be informed by a competent and able monk:

120. “Suṇātu me[P 2.0048], bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ [T 1.0199] sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya pañcāhaparivāsaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya pañcāhaparivāsaṃ adāsi. So parivasanto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ appaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya [V 0.0115] mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. So parivutthaparivāso mānattāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ appaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya [M 0.0122] sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. So parivutthaparivāso saṅghaṃ tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ adāsi. So mānattaṃ caranto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ appaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā [T 1.0200] sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ adāsi. So ciṇṇamānatto abbhānāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ appaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā appaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ adāsi. So ciṇṇamānatto saṅghaṃ abbhānaṃ yācati. Yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheyya. Esā ñatti.

120. Venerable sirs, may the Saṅgha hear me. This monk Udāyī committed one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. He requested the Saṅgha for a five-day probation for that one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. The Saṅgha granted the monk Udāyī a five-day probation for that one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. While undergoing probation, he committed an offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. He requested the Saṅgha to be drawn back to the beginning for that offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. The Saṅgha drew the monk Udāyī back to the beginning for that offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. Having completed the probation and being deserving of mānatta, he committed an offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. He requested the Saṅgha to be drawn back to the beginning for that offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. The Saṅgha drew the monk Udāyī back to the beginning for that offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. Having completed the probation, he requested the Saṅgha for a six-night mānatta for the three offenses. The Saṅgha granted the monk Udāyī a six-night mānatta for the three offenses. While undertaking mānatta, he committed an offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. He requested the Saṅgha to be drawn back to the beginning for that offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. The Saṅgha drew the monk Udāyī back to the beginning for that offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. He then requested the Saṅgha for a six-night mānatta for that offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. The Saṅgha granted the monk Udāyī a six-night mānatta for that offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. Having completed mānatta and being deserving of reinstatement, he committed an offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. He requested the Saṅgha to be drawn back to the beginning for that offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. The Saṅgha drew the monk Udāyī back to the beginning for that offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. He then requested the Saṅgha for a six-night mānatta for that offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. The Saṅgha granted the monk Udāyī a six-night mānatta for that offense of intentional emission of semen, unconcealed. Having completed mānatta, he now requests the Saṅgha for reinstatement. If it is timely for the Saṅgha, the Saṅgha should reinstate the monk Udāyī. This is the motion.

“Suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… so ciṇṇamānatto saṅghaṃ abbhānaṃ yācati. Saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheti. Yassāyasmato khamati udāyissa bhikkhuno abbhānaṃ, so tuṇhassa; yassa nakkhamati, so bhāseyya.

Venerable sirs, may the Saṅgha hear me. This monk Udāyī has committed an offense—intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days... He, having completed mānatta, requests reinstatement from the Saṅgha. The Saṅgha reinstates the monk Udāyī. To whichever venerable one the reinstatement of the monk Udāyī is agreeable, he should remain silent; whoever does not find it agreeable, he should speak.

“Dutiyampi [T 1.0201] etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe… tatiyampi etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe….

For the second time I state this matter... For the third time I state this matter...

“Abbhito [V 0.0116] saṅghena udāyī bhikkhu. Khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.

The monk Udāyī has been reinstated by the Saṅgha. It is agreeable to the Saṅgha, therefore it is silent. Thus I understand it.

Pakkhappaṭicchannaparivāso

Probation for a Half-Month Concealment

121. Tena [M 0.0123] kho pana samayena āyasmā udāyī ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno hoti sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. So bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi – “ahaṃ, āvuso, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. Kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti? Bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “Tena hi, bhikkhave, saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ detu. Evañca pana, bhikkhave, dātabbo –

121. At that time the Venerable Udāyī had committed a single offense: intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. He informed the monks, “Friends, I have committed a single offense: intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. What, I wonder, should be done by me?” They reported this matter to the Blessed One. “In that case, monks, let the Saṅgha grant the monk Udāyī a half-month period of probation for that single offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. And, monks, it should be granted thus:

“Tena, bhikkhave, udāyinā bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā…pe… evamassa vacanīyo – ‘ahaṃ, bhante, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ, bhante, saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ yācāmī’ti. Dutiyampi yācitabbo. Tatiyampi yācitabbo. Byattena bhikkhuno paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo –

Monks, that monk Udāyī, having approached the Saṅgha... should speak thus: ‘Venerable sirs, I have committed a single offense: intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. Venerable sirs, I request from the Saṅgha a half-month period of probation for that single offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month.’ He should make the request a second time. He should make the request a third time. A competent, able monk should inform the Saṅgha:

122. “Suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā [T 1.0202] sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ yācati. Yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ dadeyya. Esā ñatti.

122. Venerable sirs, may the Saṅgha listen to me. This monk Udāyī has committed a single offense: intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. He requests the Saṅgha for a half-month probation for that single offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. If it is the proper time for the Saṅgha, the Saṅgha should grant the monk Udāyī a half-month probation for that single offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. This is the motion.

“Suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ yācati. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ deti. Yassāyasmato khamati udāyissa bhikkhuno ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsassa dānaṃ, so tuṇhassa; yassa nakkhamati, so bhāseyya.

Venerable sirs, may the Saṅgha listen to me. This monk Udāyī has committed a single offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. He requests the Saṅgha for a half-month probation for that single offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. The Saṅgha grants the monk Udāyī a half-month probation for that single offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. If the granting of a half-month probation to the monk Udāyī for that single offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month, is agreeable to any venerable one, he should be silent. If it is not agreeable, he should speak.

“Dutiyampi [V 0.0117] etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe… tatiyampi etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe….

For a second time I state this matter… and so on… For a third time I state this matter… and so on…

“Dinno [M 0.0124] saṅghena udāyissa bhikkhuno ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāso. Khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.

A half-month probation has been granted by the Saṅgha to the monk Udāyī for a single offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. It is agreeable to the Saṅgha, therefore it is silent. Thus I hold it.

Pakkhapārivāsikamūlāyapaṭikassanā

Returning to the Root for One on Half-Month Probation

123. So parivasanto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. So bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi – “ahaṃ, āvuso, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho ekissā [T 1.0203] āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ parivasanto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. Kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti! Bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “Tena hi, bhikkhave, saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassitvā purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ detu. Evañca pana, bhikkhave, mūlāya paṭikassitabbo –

123. While undergoing probation, he committed an intermediate offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. He informed the monks: “Venerables, I committed a single offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. I requested the Saṅgha for half a month’s probation on account of that single offense of an intentional emission of semen concealed for half a month. The Saṅgha granted me half a month’s probation on account of that single offense of an intentional emission of semen concealed for half a month. While undergoing probation, I committed an intermediate offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. How, then, should I proceed?” They reported this matter to the Blessed One. “In that case, monks, let the Saṅgha, having returned the monk Udāyī to the root on account of the single intermediate offense of an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, give combined probation together with the former offense. And, monks, he should be returned to the root in this way:

“Tena, bhikkhave, udāyinā bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā…pe… evamassa vacanīyo – ‘ahaṃ, bhante, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ [P 2.0049] adāsi. Sohaṃ parivasanto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ, bhante, saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yācāmī’ti. Dutiyampi yācitabbā. Tatiyampi yācitabbā. Byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo –

“Monks, that monk Udāyī should approach the Saṅgha… and speak thus: ‘Venerable sirs, I committed a single offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. On account of that single offense, I requested the Saṅgha for probation for half a month. The Saṅgha granted me probation for half a month on account of that single offense. While undergoing probation, I committed in the interim a single offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. Therefore, venerable sirs, I request the Saṅgha for a return to the root on account of that single offense of an intentional emission of semen committed in the interim and concealed for five days.’ It should be requested a second time. It should be requested a third time. The Saṅgha should be informed by a competent and capable monk:”

124. “Suṇātu [T 1.0204] me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā [V 0.0118] pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ yāci[M 0.0125]. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ adāsi. So parivasanto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yācati. Yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikasseyya. Esā ñatti.

124. “Venerable sirs, may the Saṅgha hear me. This monk Udāyī committed a single offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. On account of that single offense, he requested the Saṅgha for probation for half a month. The Saṅgha granted the monk Udāyī probation for half a month on account of that single offense. While undergoing probation, he committed in the interim a single offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. He now requests the Saṅgha for a return to the root on account of that single offense of an intentional emission of semen committed in the interim and concealed for five days. If the time is right for the Saṅgha, the Saṅgha should return the monk Udāyī to the root on account of that single offense of an intentional emission of semen committed in the interim and concealed for five days. This is the motion.”

“Suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ adāsi. So parivasanto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yācati. Saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā [T 1.0205] pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassati. Yassāyasmato khamati udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanā, so tuṇhassa; yassa nakkhamati, so bhāseyya.

Venerable sirs, may the Saṅgha hear me. This monk Udāyī committed a single offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. He requested the Saṅgha for a half-month probation on account of that single offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. The Saṅgha granted the monk Udāyī a half-month probation on account of that single offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. While he was undergoing probation, he committed in the interim a single offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. He requests the Saṅgha for a return to the root on account of that single intermediate offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. The Saṅgha returns the monk Udāyī to the root on account of that single intermediate offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. To whichever venerable one the return of the monk Udāyī to the root on account of that single intermediate offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, is agreeable, he should be silent; to whomever it is not agreeable, he should speak.

“Dutiyampi etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe… tatiyampi etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe….

For a second time I state this matter… and so on… For a third time I state this matter… and so on…

“Paṭikassito saṅghena udāyī bhikkhu antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanā. Khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.

The monk Udāyī has been sent back to the beginning by the Sangha on account of one intermediate offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. This is agreeable to the Sangha, therefore it is silent. Thus do I hold this.

Samodhānaparivāso

Combined Probation

125. “Evañca pana, bhikkhave, purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāso dātabbo – tena, bhikkhave, udāyinā bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā…pe… evamassa vacanīyo – ‘ahaṃ, bhante, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ [M 0.0126] pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ ekissā [V 0.0119] āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ parivasanto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāciṃ. Taṃ maṃ saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā [T 1.0206] sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. Sohaṃ, bhante, saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ yācāmī’”ti.

125. And thus, bhikkhus, combined probation with the earlier offense should be given. That bhikkhu Udāyī should approach the Saṅgha… and should say thus: ‘Venerable sirs, I committed one offense: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight. I requested the Saṅgha for a fortnight’s probation on account of that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight. The Saṅgha granted me a fortnight’s probation on account of that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight. While on probation, I committed another offense in the interim: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. I requested the Saṅgha to be sent back to the beginning on account of that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha sent me back to the beginning on account of that one offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim. Venerable sirs, on account of this one offense of an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim, I request the Saṅgha for combined probation with the earlier offense.’

“Dutiyampi yācitabbo. Tatiyampi yācitabbo. Byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo –

He should request a second time. He should request a third time. A competent and able bhikkhu should inform the Saṅgha:

126. “Suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ adāsi. So parivasanto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ yācati. Yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya [T 1.0207] purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ dadeyya. Esā ñatti.

126. Venerable sirs, may the Saṅgha listen to me. This bhikkhu Udāyī committed one offense: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight. He requested the Saṅgha for a fortnight’s probation for one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight. The Saṅgha granted bhikkhu Udāyī a fortnight’s probation for one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight. While he was on probation, in the interim, he committed another offense: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. He requested the Saṅgha to be sent back to the beginning on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha sent bhikkhu Udāyī back to the beginning on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim. He requests the Saṅgha for a combined probation with the earlier offense, on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim. If it is the proper time for the Saṅgha, the Saṅgha may grant bhikkhu Udāyī a combined probation with the earlier offense, on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim. This is the motion.

“Suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā [M 0.0127] sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ adāsi. So parivasanto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ[V 0.0120]. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ yācati. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ deti. Yassāyasmato khamati udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsassa dānaṃ, so tuṇhassa; yassa nakkhamati, so bhāseyya.

Venerable sirs, may the Saṅgha listen to me. This bhikkhu Udāyī committed one offense: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight. He requested the Saṅgha for a fortnight’s probation on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight. The Saṅgha granted bhikkhu Udāyī a fortnight’s probation on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight. While on probation, he committed another offense in the interim: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. He requested the Saṅgha to be sent back to the beginning on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha sent bhikkhu Udāyī back to the beginning on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim. He requests the Saṅgha for combined probation with the earlier offense, on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha grants bhikkhu Udāyī combined probation with the earlier offense, on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim. If any venerable one approves of the granting of combined probation with the earlier offense to bhikkhu Udāyī on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim, let him remain silent. If anyone disapproves, let him speak.

“Dutiyampi etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe… tatiyampi etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe….

For a second time I state this matter… For a third time I state this matter….

“Dinno saṅghena udāyissa [T 1.0208] bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāso. Khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.

Combined probation with the earlier offense has been granted by the Saṅgha to bhikkhu Udāyī on account of one intermediate offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. This is agreeable to the Saṅgha, therefore it is silent. Thus do I hold this.

Mānattārahamūlāyapaṭikassanādi

On Sending Back to the Beginning for One Deserving Penance, etc.

127. So parivutthaparivāso mānattāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. So bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi – “ahaṃ, āvuso, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… sohaṃ parivutthaparivāso mānattāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. Kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti? Bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “Tena hi, bhikkhave, saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassitvā purimāya [M 0.0128] āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ detu. Evañca pana, bhikkhave, mūlāya paṭikassitabbo…pe….

127. He, having completed his probation and being deserving of penance, in the interim committed one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. He informed the bhikkhus: 'Venerable sirs, I committed one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight... I, having completed my probation and being deserving of penance, in the interim committed one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. How now should I proceed?' They reported this matter to the Blessed One. 'In that case, bhikkhus, the Saṅgha, having sent the bhikkhu Udāyī back to the beginning on account of that one offense of intentional emission of semen committed in the interim and concealed for five days, should grant concurrent probation for the earlier offense. And this, bhikkhus, is how he should be sent back to the beginning...'

“Evañca pana, bhikkhave, purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāso dātabbo…pe… deti…pe….

'And this, bhikkhus, is how concurrent probation for the earlier offense should be given... he gives...'

“Dinno saṅghena udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā [V 0.0121] pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāso. Khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.

'Concurrent probation for the earlier offense has been given by the Saṅgha to the bhikkhu Udāyī on account of the one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim. It is approved by the Saṅgha, therefore it is silent. Thus do I hold this.'

Tikāpattimānattaṃ

Penance for Three Offenses

128. So parivutthaparivāso bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi – “ahaṃ, āvuso, ekaṃ [T 1.0209] āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… sohaṃ parivutthaparivāso. Kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti? Bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “Tena hi[P 2.0050], bhikkhave, saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ detu. Evañca pana, bhikkhave, dātabbaṃ –

128. He, having completed his probation, informed the bhikkhus: 'Venerable sirs, I committed one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight... I have completed my probation. How now should I proceed?' They reported this matter to the Blessed One. 'In that case, bhikkhus, the Saṅgha should grant the bhikkhu Udāyī penance for six nights for the three offenses. And this, bhikkhus, is how it should be given:'

“Tena, bhikkhave, udāyinā bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā…pe… evamassa vacanīyo – ‘ahaṃ, bhante, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… sohaṃ, bhante, parivutthaparivāso saṅghaṃ tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yācāmī’ti. Dutiyampi yācitabbaṃ. Tatiyampi yācitabbaṃ. Byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo –

Bhikkhus, that bhikkhu Udāyī, having approached the Saṅgha... should speak thus: 'Venerable sirs, I have committed one intentional offense of semen emission, concealed for a fortnight... Venerable sirs, I, having completed the probation, request from the Saṅgha penance for six nights on account of three offenses.' It should be requested a second time. It should be requested a third time. The Saṅgha should be informed by a competent, capable bhikkhu:

129. “Suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… so parivutthaparivāso saṅghaṃ tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yācati. Yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ dadeyya. Esā ñatti.

129. Venerable sirs, may the Saṅgha listen to me. This bhikkhu Udāyī has committed one intentional offense of semen emission, concealed for a fortnight... Having completed his probation, he requests from the Saṅgha penance for six nights for the three offenses. If it is the proper time for the Saṅgha, the Saṅgha should grant the bhikkhu Udāyī penance for six nights for the three offenses. This is the motion.

“Suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… so parivutthaparivāso saṅghaṃ tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yācati. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno [T 1.0210] tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ deti. Yassāyasmato khamati [M 0.0129] udāyissa bhikkhuno tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattassa dānaṃ, so tuṇhassa; yassa nakkhamati, so bhāseyya.

Venerable sirs, may the Saṅgha listen to me. This bhikkhu Udāyī has committed one intentional offense of semen emission, concealed for a fortnight... Having completed his probation, he requests from the Saṅgha penance for six nights for the three offenses. The Saṅgha gives the bhikkhu Udāyī penance for six nights for the three offenses. To whichever venerable one the giving of penance for six nights for the three offenses to the bhikkhu Udāyī is agreeable, he should remain silent; whoever does not agree, he should speak.

“Dutiyampi etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe… tatiyampi etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe….

For a second time I speak on this matter... For a third time I speak on this matter...

“Dinnaṃ [V 0.0122] saṅghena udāyissa bhikkhuno tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ. Khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.

Penance for six nights for the three offenses has been given by the Saṅgha to the bhikkhu Udāyī. It is agreeable to the Saṅgha, therefore it is silent. Thus do I record this.

Mānattacārikamūlāyapaṭikassanādi

Sending Back to the Beginning for One Undergoing Mānatta, and so on

130. So mānattaṃ caranto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. So bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi – “ahaṃ, āvuso, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… sohaṃ mānattaṃ caranto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. Kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti? Bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “Tena hi, bhikkhave, saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassitvā purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ datvā chārattaṃ mānattaṃ detu. Evañca pana, bhikkhave, mūlāya paṭikassitabbo…pe….

130. While undertaking penance, he committed in the interim one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. He informed the bhikkhus: 'Venerable sirs, I committed one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight... I, while undertaking penance, committed in the interim one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. How should I now proceed?' They reported this matter to the Blessed One. 'In that case, bhikkhus, the Saṅgha, having sent the bhikkhu Udāyī back to the beginning on account of the one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim, and having given a concurrent probation for the earlier offense, should give penance for six nights. And this, bhikkhus, is how one should be sent back to the beginning...'

“Evañca pana, bhikkhave, purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāso dātabbo…pe….

And this is how, bhikkhus, concurrent probation for the earlier offense should be given…

“Evañca pana, bhikkhave, chārattaṃ mānattaṃ dātabbaṃ…pe… deti…pe…[T 1.0211].

And this, bhikkhus, is how penance for six nights should be given... he gives...

“Dinnaṃ saṅghena udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ. Khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.

Penance for six nights has been given by the Saṅgha to the bhikkhu Udāyī on account of the one offense of intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days, committed in the interim. It is approved by the Saṅgha; therefore, it is silent. Thus I record this.

Abbhānārahamūlāyapaṭikassanādi

Sending Back to the Beginning for One Worthy of Rehabilitation, and so on

131. So ciṇṇamānatto abbhānāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. So bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi – “ahaṃ, āvuso, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… sohaṃ ciṇṇamānatto abbhānāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. Kathaṃ nu kho mayā [M 0.0130] paṭipajjitabba”nti? Bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “Tena hi, bhikkhave, saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassitvā purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ datvā chārattaṃ mānattaṃ detu. Evañca pana, bhikkhave, mūlāya paṭikassitabbo…pe….

131. He, having completed the mānatta and while being worthy of rehabilitation, in the interim fell into one offense: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. He informed the monks: 'Venerable sirs, I fell into one offense: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight... I, having completed the mānatta and while being worthy of rehabilitation, in the interim fell into one offense: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. How should I now proceed?' They reported this matter to the Blessed One. 'In that case, monks, the Sangha, on account of the one interim offense of an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, having sent the monk Udāyī back to the beginning and having given a concurrent probation for the earlier offense, should give mānatta for six nights. And this, monks, is how one should be sent back to the beginning...'

“Evañca [V 0.0123] pana, bhikkhave, purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāso dātabbo…pe….

And this, monks, is how concurrent probation for the earlier offense should be given...

“Evañca pana, bhikkhave, chārattaṃ mānattaṃ dātabbaṃ…pe… deti…pe….

And this, monks, is how mānatta for six nights should be given... gives...

“Dinnaṃ saṅghena udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ. Khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.

Mānatta for six nights has been given by the Sangha to the monk Udāyī on account of the one interim offense of an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. It is approved by the Sangha; therefore, it is silent. Thus I record this.

Pakkhappaṭicchannaabbhānaṃ

Rehabilitation for an Offense Concealed for a Fortnight

132. So [T 1.0212][P 2.0051] ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi – “ahaṃ, āvuso, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… sohaṃ ciṇṇamānatto. Kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti? Bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “Tena hi, bhikkhave, saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ abbhetu. Evañca pana, bhikkhave, abbhetabbo –

132. He, having completed the mānatta, informed the monks: 'Venerable sirs, I fell into one offense: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight... I have completed the mānatta. How should I now proceed?' They reported this matter to the Blessed One. 'In that case, monks, let the Sangha rehabilitate the monk Udāyī. And, monks, he should be rehabilitated thus:—'

“Tena, bhikkhave, udāyinā bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā, ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā, vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā, ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā, añjaliṃ paggahetvā, evamassa vacanīyo – ‘ahaṃ, bhante, ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ parivasanto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāciṃ. Taṃ maṃ saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā [M 0.0131] sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa [T 1.0213] me saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ parivutthaparivāso mānattāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāciṃ. Taṃ maṃ saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā [V 0.0124] pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya [T 1.0214] purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ parivutthaparivāso saṅghaṃ tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ mānattaṃ caranto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāciṃ. Taṃ maṃ saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ parivutthaparivāso saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ ciṇṇamānatto abbhānāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāciṃ. Taṃ maṃ saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya [M 0.0132] mūlāya paṭikassi. Sohaṃ saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā [T 1.0215] pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ parivutthaparivāso saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yāciṃ. Tassa me saṅgho antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ adāsi. Sohaṃ, bhante, ciṇṇamānatto saṅghaṃ abbhānaṃ yācāmī’”ti.

“Monks, that monk Udāyī should approach the Saṅgha, arrange his upper robe over one shoulder, pay homage at the feet of the senior monks, sit down in a squatting position, raise his joined palms, and should speak thus: ‘Venerable sirs, I committed one offense: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for a fortnight. I requested the Saṅgha for a fortnight’s probation for one offense, an intentional emission of semen concealed for a fortnight. The Saṅgha granted me a fortnight’s probation for that one offense, an intentional emission of semen concealed for a fortnight. While undergoing probation, I committed one offense in the interim: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. I requested the Saṅgha to be sent back to the beginning for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. The Saṅgha sent me back to the beginning for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. I then requested the Saṅgha for combined probation for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, together with the previous offense. The Saṅgha granted me combined probation for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, together with the previous offense. Having completed the probation and being eligible for mānatta, I committed one offense in the interim: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. I requested the Saṅgha to be sent back to the beginning for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. The Saṅgha sent me back to the beginning for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. I then requested the Saṅgha for combined probation for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, together with the previous offense. The Saṅgha granted me combined probation for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, together with the previous offense. Having completed the probation, I requested the Saṅgha for a six-night mānatta for the three offenses. The Saṅgha granted me a six-night mānatta for the three offenses. While undergoing mānatta, I committed one offense in the interim: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. I requested the Saṅgha to be sent back to the beginning for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. The Saṅgha sent me back to the beginning for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. I then requested the Saṅgha for combined probation for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, together with the previous offense. The Saṅgha granted me combined probation for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, together with the previous offense. Having completed the probation, I requested the Saṅgha for a six-night mānatta for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. The Saṅgha granted me a six-night mānatta for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. Having completed mānatta and being eligible for reinstatement, I committed one offense in the interim: an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. I requested the Saṅgha to be sent back to the beginning for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. The Saṅgha sent me back to the beginning for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. I then requested the Saṅgha for combined probation for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, together with the previous offense. The Saṅgha granted me combined probation for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, together with the previous offense. Having completed the probation, I requested the Saṅgha for a six-night mānatta for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. The Saṅgha granted me a six-night mānatta for that one offense committed in the interim, an intentional emission of semen concealed for five days. Venerable sirs, having completed mānatta, I request the Saṅgha for reinstatement.’”

“Dutiyampi yācitabbaṃ. Tatiyampi yācitabbaṃ. Byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo –

It should be requested a second time. It should be requested a third time. The Saṅgha should be informed by a competent and able monk:

133. “Suṇātu [V 0.0125] me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pakkhappaṭicchannāya pakkhaparivāsaṃ adāsi. So parivasanto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ adāsi. So parivutthaparivāso mānattāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ [T 1.0216] pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā [M 0.0133] āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ adāsi. So parivutthaparivāso saṅghaṃ tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno tissannaṃ āpattīnaṃ chārattaṃ mānattaṃ adāsi. So mānattaṃ caranto antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ adāsi. So parivutthaparivāso [T 1.0217] saṅghaṃ so saṃghaṃ (ka.) antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ [V 0.0126] adāsi. So ciṇṇamānatto abbhānāraho antarā ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pañcāhappaṭicchannaṃ. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāyapaṭikassanaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya mūlāya paṭikassi. So saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya purimāya āpattiyā samodhānaparivāsaṃ adāsi. So parivutthaparivāso saṅghaṃ antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ [M 0.0134] mānattaṃ yāci. Saṅgho udāyissa bhikkhuno antarā ekissā āpattiyā sañcetanikāya sukkavissaṭṭhiyā pañcāhappaṭicchannāya chārattaṃ mānattaṃ adāsi. So ciṇṇamānatto saṅghaṃ abbhānaṃ yācati. Yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheyya. Esā ñatti.

133. Venerable sirs, may the Saṅgha listen to me. This bhikkhu Udāyī committed one offense, an intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month. He requested the Saṅgha for half a month’s probation for one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for half a month. The Saṅgha granted the bhikkhu Udāyī half a month’s probation for one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for half a month. While undergoing probation, in the interim, he committed one offense, an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. He requested the Saṅgha for relegation to the beginning on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha relegated the bhikkhu Udāyī to the beginning on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim. He requested the Saṅgha for conjoined probation for one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim, together with the previous offense. The Saṅgha granted the bhikkhu Udāyī conjoined probation for one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim, together with the previous offense. Having completed his probation, being eligible for mānatta, in the interim, he committed one offense, an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. He requested the Saṅgha for relegation to the beginning on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha relegated the bhikkhu Udāyī to the beginning on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim. He requested the Saṅgha for conjoined probation for one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim, together with the previous offense. The Saṅgha granted the bhikkhu Udāyī conjoined probation for one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim, together with the previous offense. Having completed his probation, he requested the Saṅgha for a six-night mānatta for the three offenses. The Saṅgha granted the bhikkhu Udāyī a six-night mānatta for the three offenses. While undergoing mānatta, in the interim, he committed one offense, an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. He requested the Saṅgha for relegation to the beginning on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha relegated the bhikkhu Udāyī to the beginning on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim. He requested the Saṅgha for conjoined probation for one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim, together with the previous offense. The Saṅgha granted the bhikkhu Udāyī conjoined probation for one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim, together with the previous offense. Having completed his probation, he requested the Saṅgha for a six-night mānatta on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha granted the bhikkhu Udāyī a six-night mānatta on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim. Having completed the mānatta, being eligible for rehabilitation, in the interim, he committed one offense, an intentional emission of semen, concealed for five days. He requested the Saṅgha for relegation to the beginning on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha relegated the bhikkhu Udāyī to the beginning on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim. He requested the Saṅgha for conjoined probation for one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim, together with the previous offense. The Saṅgha granted the bhikkhu Udāyī conjoined probation for one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim, together with the previous offense. Having completed his probation, he requested the Saṅgha for a six-night mānatta on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim. The Saṅgha granted the bhikkhu Udāyī a six-night mānatta on account of one offense of intentional emission of semen concealed for five days, committed in the interim. Having completed the mānatta, he requests the Saṅgha for rehabilitation. If it is the proper time for the Saṅgha, the Saṅgha may rehabilitate the bhikkhu Udāyī. This is the motion.

“Suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ udāyī bhikkhu ekaṃ āpattiṃ [T 1.0218] āpajji sañcetanikaṃ sukkavissaṭṭhiṃ pakkhappaṭicchannaṃ…pe… so ciṇṇamānatto saṅghaṃ abbhānaṃ yācati. Saṅgho udāyiṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheti. Yassāyasmato khamati udāyissa bhikkhuno abbhānaṃ, so tuṇhassa; yassa nakkhamati, so bhāseyya.

Venerable sirs, may the Saṅgha listen to me. This bhikkhu Udāyī committed one offense, an intentional emission of semen, concealed for half a month... Having completed the mānatta, he requests the Saṅgha for rehabilitation. The Saṅgha rehabilitates the bhikkhu Udāyī. To whichever venerable one the rehabilitation of the bhikkhu Udāyī is agreeable, let him be silent; to whom it is not agreeable, let him speak.

“Dutiyampi etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe… tatiyampi etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe….

For a second time I state this matter... For a third time I state this matter...

“Abbhito saṅghena udāyī bhikkhu. Khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.

The bhikkhu Udāyī has been rehabilitated by the Saṅgha. It is agreeable to the Saṅgha, therefore there is silence. Thus I hold this.

Sukkavissaṭṭhi samattā.

The section on the emission of semen is concluded.

2. Parivāso

2. Probation

Agghasamodhānaparivāso

Consolidated Probation by Value

134. Tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sambahulā saṅghādisesā āpattiyo āpanno hoti – ekā āpatti ekāhappaṭicchannā, ekā āpatti dvīhappaṭicchannā, ekā āpatti tīhappaṭicchannā, ekā āpatti catūhappaṭicchannā, ekā āpatti pañcāhappaṭicchannā, ekā [V 0.0127] āpatti chāhappaṭicchannā, ekā āpatti sattāhappaṭicchannā, ekā āpatti aṭṭhāhappaṭicchannā, ekā āpatti navāhappaṭicchannā, ekā āpatti dasāhappaṭicchannā. So bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi – “ahaṃ, āvuso, sambahulā saṅghādisesā āpattiyo āpajjiṃ – ekā āpatti ekāhappaṭicchannā…pe… ekā āpatti dasāhappaṭicchannā. Kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti? Bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “Tena hi, bhikkhave, saṅgho tassa bhikkhuno tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ yā āpatti dasāhappaṭicchannā [T 1.0219] tassā agghena samodhānaparivāsaṃ detu. Evañca pana, bhikkhave, dātabbo –

134. At that time, a certain bhikkhu had committed several Saṅghādisesa offenses: one offense concealed for one day, one offense concealed for two days, one offense concealed for three days, one offense concealed for four days, one offense concealed for five days, one offense concealed for six days, one offense concealed for seven days, one offense concealed for eight days, one offense concealed for nine days, and one offense concealed for ten days. He informed the bhikkhus, “Venerable sirs, I have committed several Saṅghādisesa offenses: one offense concealed for one day… up to one offense concealed for ten days. How should I now proceed?” They reported this matter to the Blessed One. “In that case, bhikkhus, let the Saṅgha grant that bhikkhu a consolidated probation based on the value of the offense that was concealed for ten days out of those offenses. And, bhikkhus, it should be granted in this way:

“Tena[M 0.0135], bhikkhave, bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā…pe… evamassa vacanīyo – ‘ahaṃ, bhante, sambahulā saṅghādisesā āpattiyo āpajjiṃ – ekā āpatti ekāhappaṭicchannā…pe… ekā āpatti dasāhappaṭicchannā. Sohaṃ, bhante, saṅghaṃ tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ yā āpatti dasāhappaṭicchannā tassā agghena samodhānaparivāsaṃ yācāmī’ti. Dutiyampi yācitabbo. Tatiyampi yācitabbo. Byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo –

“O bhikkhus, that bhikkhu should approach the Saṅgha… and say: ‘Venerable Sirs, I have committed several Saṅghādisesa offenses: one offense concealed for one day… up to one offense concealed for ten days. I, that person, Venerable Sirs, request from the Saṅgha a consolidated probation for those offenses, reckoned by the value of the offense which was concealed for ten days.’ He should request a second time. He should request a third time. A competent and capable bhikkhu should inform the Saṅgha:”

135. “Suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu sambahulā saṅghādisesā [P 2.0052] āpattiyo āpajji – ekā āpatti ekāhappaṭicchannā…pe… ekā āpatti dasāhappaṭicchannā. So saṅghaṃ tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ yā āpatti dasāhappaṭicchannā tassā agghena samodhānaparivāsaṃ yācati. Yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho itthannāmassa bhikkhuno tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ yā āpatti dasāhappaṭicchannā tassā agghena samodhānaparivāsaṃ dadeyya. Esā ñatti.

135. “Venerable Sirs, may the Saṅgha hear me. This bhikkhu named so-and-so has committed several Saṅghādisesa offenses: one offense concealed for one day… up to one offense concealed for ten days. He requests from the Saṅgha a consolidated probation for those offenses, reckoned by the value of the offense which was concealed for ten days. If it is the proper time for the Saṅgha, the Saṅgha should grant a consolidated probation to this bhikkhu named so-and-so for those offenses, reckoned by the value of the offense which was concealed for ten days. This is the motion.”

“Suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. Ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu sambahulā saṅghādisesā āpattiyo āpajji – ekā āpatti ekāhappaṭicchannā…pe… ekā āpatti dasāhappaṭicchannā. So saṅghaṃ tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ yā [T 1.0220] āpatti dasāhappaṭicchannā tassā agghena samodhānaparivāsaṃ yācati. Saṅgho itthannāmassa bhikkhuno tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ yā āpatti dasāhappaṭicchannā tassā agghena samodhānaparivāsaṃ deti. Yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ yā āpatti dasāhappaṭicchannā; tassā agghena samodhānaparivāsassa dānaṃ, so tuṇhassa; yassa nakkhamati, so bhāseyya.

“Venerable Sirs, may the Saṅgha hear me. This bhikkhu named so-and-so has committed several Saṅghādisesa offenses: one offense concealed for one day… up to one offense concealed for ten days. He requests from the Saṅgha a consolidated probation for those offenses, reckoned by the value of the offense which was concealed for ten days. The Saṅgha grants a consolidated probation to this bhikkhu named so-and-so for those offenses, reckoned by the value of the offense which was concealed for ten days. Whichever venerable one approves of the granting of a consolidated probation to this bhikkhu named so-and-so for those offenses, reckoned by the value of the offense which was concealed for ten days, he should remain silent. Whichever one does not approve, he should speak.”

“Dutiyampi [V 0.0128] etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe… tatiyampi etamatthaṃ vadāmi…pe….

“For a second time, I state this matter… For a third time, I state this matter….”

“Dinno saṅghena itthannāmassa bhikkhuno tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ yā āpatti dasāhappaṭicchannā tassā agghena samodhānaparivāso. Khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.

“A consolidated probation has been granted by the Saṅgha to the bhikkhu named so-and-so for those offenses, reckoned by the value of the offense which was concealed for ten days. It is approved by the Saṅgha, therefore there is silence. Thus do I hold this.”

Sabbacirappaṭicchannaagghasamodhānaṃ

Consolidated Probation Reckoned by the Value of the Longest-Concealed Offenses

136. Tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sambahulā saṅghādisesā āpattiyo āpanno hoti – ekā āpatti ekāhappaṭicchannā[M 0.0136], dve āpattiyo dvīhappaṭicchannāyo dvīhappaṭicchannā (ka. evaṃ yāvadasāhappaṭicchannā), tisso āpattiyo tīhappaṭicchannāyo, catasso āpattiyo catūhappaṭicchannāyo, pañca āpattiyo pañcāhappaṭicchannāyo, cha āpattiyo chāhappaṭicchannāyo, satta āpattiyo sattāhappaṭicchannāyo, aṭṭha āpattiyo aṭṭhāhappaṭicchannāyo, nava āpattiyo navāhappaṭicchannāyo, dasa āpattiyo dasāhappaṭicchannāyo. So bhikkhūnaṃ ārocesi – “ahaṃ, āvuso, sambahulā saṅghādisesā āpattiyo āpajjiṃ, ekā āpatti ekāhappaṭicchannā…pe… dasa āpattiyo dasāhappaṭicchannāyo[T 1.0221]. Kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabba”nti? Bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. “Tena hi, bhikkhave, saṅgho tassa bhikkhuno tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ yā āpattiyo sabbacirappaṭicchannāyo tāsaṃ agghena samodhānaparivāsaṃ detu. Evañca pana, bhikkhave, dātabbo –

136. At that time, a certain bhikkhu had committed several Saṅghādisesa offenses: one offense concealed for one day, two offenses concealed for two days, three offenses concealed for three days, four offenses concealed for four days, five offenses concealed for five days, six offenses concealed for six days, seven offenses concealed for seven days, eight offenses concealed for eight days, nine offenses concealed for nine days, and ten offenses concealed for ten days. He told the bhikkhus: “Friends, I have committed several Saṅghādisesa offenses: one offense concealed for one day… up to ten offenses concealed for ten days. How, indeed, should I proceed?” They reported this matter to the Blessed One. “In that case, bhikkhus, let the Saṅgha grant that bhikkhu a consolidated probation for those offenses, reckoned by the value of the offenses that were concealed for the longest time. And this, bhikkhus, is how it should be granted:

“Tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā…pe… evamassa vacanīyo – ‘ahaṃ, bhante, sambahulā saṅghādisesā āpattiyo āpajjiṃ, ekā āpatti ekāhappaṭicchannā…pe… dasa āpattiyo dasāhappaṭicchannāyo. Sohaṃ, bhante, saṅghaṃ tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ yā āpattiyo sabbacirappaṭicchannāyo tāsaṃ agghena samodhānaparivāsaṃ yācāmī’ti. Dutiyampi yācitabbo. Tatiyampi yācitabbo. “Byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo –

“That bhikkhu, bhikkhus, should approach the Saṅgha… and should speak thus: ‘Venerable Sirs, I have committed several Saṅghādisesa offenses: one offense concealed for one day… up to ten offenses concealed for ten days. I, that person, Venerable Sirs, request from the Saṅgha a consolidated probation for those offenses, reckoned by the value of the offenses that were concealed for the longest time.’ He should make the request a second time.
